nodes.title: 参考载入事项
widgets_values:
通过限制视频的最长边来减少视频尺寸可以大幅度提高clip视觉编码速度与视频生成速度，并且降低显存消耗，酌情进行调整，但是由于qkv分块的存在不用过于担心爆显存，调大分辨率也没事。

限制设为0时代表不缩小分辨率。

裁切视频范围应按官方条件限制为最低两秒，最长15秒。

nodes.title: 启动参数
widgets_values:
推荐运行环境（参数名称可能因启动器和 ComfyUI 版本不同）：

• 启用 cudaMallocAsync 异步显存分配器  
• 启用异步权重卸载，建议约 2 个传输流  
• 保持 Pinned Memory／锁页内存开启，容量交由 ComfyUI 按系统内存自动计算  
• 启用智能显存管理或 DynamicVRAM  
• 在启动器或 NVIDIA CUDA 驱动设置中优先禁止系统内存兜底，避免显存不足后无提示地进入极慢状态  
• VAE 优先使用 GPU，显存确实不足时再改用 CPU  

以上属于推荐环境而非节点硬性依赖。请根据本机 ComfyUI、启动器、显卡显存和驱动版本核对对应设置，勿直接照搬其他整合包的参数名称。

nodes.title: 模型载入
widgets_values:
20系以及不支持bf16的需要启用该loader修复节点，优化内容可跳转github查看详情。新版架构显卡可以使用comfyui默认unet加载器加载模型。新版加载器已兼容新架构显卡，注意检查自己的启动器参数不要开启fp16，否则会产生溢出错误。其他修复节点也可能会导致不兼容的现象。

模型链接：https://pan.quark.cn/s/27f28ba550dc

缺失节点请在管理器中安装，便于下次更新：

https://github.com/star7code/minimax-h3-chunk-star7.git

https://github.com/star7code/minimax-h3-fp16-exact-star7.git

nodes.title: Lora注意事项
widgets_values:
对于目前的测试来说，larryvrh的minimax_h3_turbo_v4_step600对于真实人物的油腻感较轻，更为自然，但是需要使用这个作者的专用lora加载器加载该lora，否则画面会模糊崩坏。也可以使用网盘中的minimax_h3_turbo_v4_step600_comfyui_T8-convert转化版直接用comfyui的lora加载器进行加载，无需使用特殊lora加载器。

之前使用v4_step600日志中的报错是由于该lora匹配完整版模型，使用剪枝模型时由于部分模块无法对应产生报错，最新版已经兼容该问题。

Sigma Shift需要根据不同lora设定的进行改动，大部分情况4步lora为 6 / 3 ,8步为 12 / 3 ，绕过节点即可恢复默认 12 / 3 ，以实际lora公布参数为主。

nodes.title: Sigma Shift与分块加速提醒事项
widgets_values:
注意力加速切记按照自己的显卡选择，20系选择sm75系列，这个是为了20系专门预编译好的。新架构选择sm80+，ck是通用的，或者选择existing然后在前面自行连接kjsage等注意力加速节点。

注意力选择中ck质量最佳、sol其次、sla一般，但是速度会大幅度提升，高负载情况下尤为明显。在1.0MP分辨率、10秒、4步lora、参考图生视频参数下分别为620秒、442秒、350秒。使用hybird混合注意力可平衡速度与质量。

对于2080ti 22g显卡三个参数保持8192即可，显存未占满并不会影响速度。如果在超高参数下遇到爆显存的情况（如2.0 10秒）可以开启输出显存保护，默认关闭，开启可能会导致降速。

nodes.title: 导出事项
widgets_values:
该选项可以自动将工作流内置保存在视频中，后续通过该节点生成的视频可以拖动到提示词载入节点处来快速导入当时使用的提示词。

注意保存的工作流视频如果通过微信等方式发送会导致被压缩而失去内置工作流。使用仅视频时将不会保存工作流。

还可以使用视频+工作流png来保存一张带有第一帧视频图片的工作流图片，占用存储小可以当做可视化工作流模板卡。

nodes.title: 二采注意事项
widgets_values:
使用该二采节点需要下载minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_fp16.safetensors模型放置models\latent_upscale_models文件夹内

按照自己机器的性能尽量将每格的像素压在1.0以内，例如4.0使用四格甚至六格，原理是逐块生成最后拼接为高画质视频

已内置运行自动下载，但是可能会失败，手动下载放置更稳妥。

如果只需要人脸修复节点，双击搜索人脸修复节点替换该节点即可，需要下载并放置对应yolo模型：models\ultralytics\bbox\face_yolov8m.pt

widgets_values:
integrated_multimodal_description:

[Shot 1]
Live-action, cinematic, modern police-procedural thriller. A realistic forensic evidence room inside a criminal investigation unit. The lighting is cool, clean, and professional, with practical overhead light, computer monitor glow, and a restrained high-end procedural atmosphere.

A young detective stands beside a forensic workstation, holding a clean latent fingerprint film carefully between two fingers. A comparison monitor beside him shows a forensic match result clearly indicating a complete match to the deceased, forming an apparently perfect suicide-evidence chain.

The camera begins in a level medium close shot, clean and controlled, with no visual excess. The mood feels routine, efficient, and believable, like a normal case conclusion inside a professional police team.

The young detective looks toward the team leader with confidence and says in a firm, matter-of-fact voice (S1):
<d>[Chinese] 队长，现场只有死者指纹，自杀定论没问题。</d>

No subtitles or captions appear on screen.

The monitor interface remains visible in the background, suggesting a conclusive forensic match, while keyboard taps and equipment hum continue underneath the line.

[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the camera cuts to a macro close-up.

A middle-aged team leader leans in. His expression turns sharp and intensely focused. The lens pushes into the fingerprint film and isolates one extremely subtle flaw near the outer edge: a tiny artificial trimming mark, almost invisible at first glance.

The environment sound narrows dramatically. The room tone falls away. No one speaks.

The camera pushes in further with microscopic attention to detail, locking onto the faint cut-like edge on the fingerprint film. The tension suddenly shifts from routine certainty to silent suspicion.

The team leader's breathing becomes just barely audible. His gaze hardens as he realizes the evidence has been manipulated.

[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts to a tight side-profile shot of the team leader.

The lighting becomes slightly darker and more contrast-driven, while the background softly falls away. His face remains calm, but his eyes carry cold certainty and controlled anger. The implication lands instantly: someone falsified evidence and tried to force the case into a closed suicide ruling.

He speaks quietly, firmly, and with piercing authority (S2):
<d>[Chinese] 指纹是后贴的。这不是自杀，是有人故意破坏现场。</d>

No subtitles or captions appear on screen.

Hold for a beat on his side profile as the meaning settles. The shot ends with a powerful suspenseful freeze in the atmosphere, as if a much larger hidden case has just begun to surface.

overall_soundscape:

Subtle keyboard tapping, low forensic equipment hum, quiet office room tone, and restrained investigative ambience in the opening. During the macro discovery shot, the environmental sound compresses until almost everything drops away except a faint breath and minimal room presence. In the final shot, a low tense silence dominates, allowing the final line to land with maximum weight.

non_diegetic_music:

A restrained modern investigative thriller score begins with subtle low-frequency pulses and minimal sustained textures. The music remains understated during the opening procedural setup. At the discovery of the trimming mark, the score tightens into sparse suspense. In the final shot, a deep low cinematic accent lands beneath the team leader's conclusion, followed by a lingering unresolved suspense tone that leaves a strong hook for a larger conspiracy.
